newsitem.title: UK: House boom lifts building society valuations - paper.
newsitem.headline: House boom lifts building society valuations - paper.

text.p: The prospect of a boom in the housing market is driving up estimates of the value of bonuses to be paid by the Woolwich Building Society when it converts to a bank, the Independent newspaper reported on Tuesday.

The recovery in house prices is also expected to give a similar boost to the value of the Halifax and other converting societies after fuelling share price rises at Abbey National and Lloyds TSB, according to the Independent.

These are among benchmark shares used to help set the stock market value of the converting societies and industry analysts now estimate the Halifax's flotation to be worth at least 12 billion pounds ($20.27 billion), the newspaper said. ($1=.5921 Pound)
